reviews.author: Manu Ambadiveliyil (Manu Ambadiveliyil)
reviews.text:
Went to Calicut Stories, Karama for an early dinner with family. The restaurant has a decent, neat ambience and was only partly filled when we arrived, probably because we were a little early. Still, we had to wait around 15 minutes before getting settled. Parking around this part of Karama can also be quite difficult, particularly during peak hours.

Service was okay, but this is one area where they could improve. The staff could be a little more welcoming, friendly and attentive, which would make the overall dining experience much better.

Coming to the food — this is where Calicut Stories really impressed us. We tried Cream of Tomato, Seafood Soup, Chicken Lolly Pop Sauteed, Fish Tharavadi, Chilli Prawns, along with Chapathi and Kerala Porotta. The food was really tasty overall, with good flavours and that familiar Kerala/Malabar touch. Even the simple Fresh Milk Tea was excellent and deserves a mention!

The portions and pricing also felt quite reasonable for Dubai, especially considering the quality of the food.

Overall, a must-try place for good Kerala food in Karama. Improve the warmth and attentiveness of the service a little, and the overall experience can easily move up another level.

Would definitely return to explore more of their menu. 👍
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you, Manu, for such a thoughtful and detailed review. We truly appreciate you taking the time to share this. We’re especially happy that the food made such a strong impression.
Your comments about the service are equally valuable. We agree that being warm, welcoming, and attentive is an important part of the Calicut Stories experience, and we’ll make sure your feedback reaches our Karama team.
And knowing you’d return to explore more of the menu is a lovely compliment. We’ll look forward to welcoming you and hopefully making your next visit even better

reviews.author: Tippu VH
reviews.text:
I visited Calicut Stories for the first time, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience.

The first thing that caught my attention was the beautiful ambience, which was welcoming, and spotlessly clean. On top of that, the prices are very reasonable considering the exceptional taste and quality of the food.

If you’re a fan of authentic Malabari cuisine, this place is a must-visit. We had planned to try their biryani, but since we visited at night, it wasn’t available. Instead, we ordered the Neypathal, Beef Pollichathu, Appam, and their signature Jeguts Special drink. Every single item was extraordinary and honestly finger-licking good! The flavours were authentic, perfectly balanced, and left us wanting more.

But the biggest asset of Calicut Stories isn’t just the food, it’s Mr. Shibin. I’m not sure whether he’s a waiter or part of the sales team, but he is truly exceptional at what he does. His hospitality, warmth, and genuine enthusiasm made our visit even more memorable. We ended up having a great conversation with him, and it felt like talking to an old friend.

A restaurant with good food can always attract customers, but it’s people like Shibin who turn a good dining experience into an unforgettable one. Management, if you’re reading this—give the man a raise and do everything you can to keep him. Staff members like him are rare and make all the difference.

I’ll definitely be coming back, and I’ll be recommending Calicut Stories to my friends and family. Looking forward to trying the biryani on my next visit!

reviews.author: Sakeer Hussin
reviews.text:
This was my third visit to the restaurant, and I am delighted to say that the experience was exceptional once again. From the moment I arrived, the staff were warm, attentive, and professional, ensuring that every aspect of the dining experience was comfortable and enjoyable.

The quality of the food was outstanding. On this visit, I decided to try the newly launched Prawns Kanthari, and it exceeded all my expectations. The prawns were fresh, perfectly cooked, and infused with the rich, aromatic flavors of the Kanthari spices. The balance of heat and flavor was excellent, making it one of the best seafood dishes I have tasted recently. Every bite was packed with authentic taste and great attention to detail.

The service deserves special appreciation especially . The team was knowledgeable about the menu, quick in responding to requests, and genuinely committed to providing excellent hospitality. Their friendliness and efficiency added significantly to the overall experience.

The restaurant continues to maintain high standards in both food quality and customer service, which is why I keep returning. Consistency is difficult to achieve, but this restaurant delivers it remarkably well. I highly recommend trying the Prawns Kanthari and would gladly recommend this place to anyone looking for delicious food, excellent service, and a memorable dining experience.

reviews.author: Viknesh Sadasivan
reviews.text:
The food at Calicut Stories was genuinely good, and the staff inside the restaurant were friendly, helpful, and attentive. They offered solid recommendations and made the dining experience pleasant.

Unfortunately, the staff managing incoming customers outside left a very different impression. Even though there was clearly space available for two inside, they insisted we take the outdoor setup. This felt like an unfair and inappropriate practice.

Good food alone isn’t enough. Respect and dignity matter just as much. Because of this experience, we won’t be returning.

reviews.author: Shahmnf
reviews.text:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Awesome Dining Experience at Calicut Stories !!

We visited Calicut Stories as a large family group of about 15 to 20 people for dinner, and everything from the food to the hospitality was absolutely exceptional. Managing a group of our size can be challenging, but the team handled it flawlessly.

#### Food
The food was incredibly delicious. Every dish was packed with flavor and cooked to perfection. A few highlights from our table:

The chili chicken was perfectly sauced and flavorful that pairs beautifully with their flaky, layered porottas.

We loved the refreshing mango salad and the beautifully presented spiced mango chunks topped with chili flakes, such a perfect blend of sweet, tangy, and spicy flavors to kick off the meal.

We wrapped up our dinner with their signature Royal  Faloodas, which were rich, refreshing, and the perfect sweet ending to an amazing feast ...

### Exceptional Service

A huge, special mention goes to Sooraj S, who took care of us throughout the evening. He was incredibly welcoming, attentive and maintained a very pleasant and warm demeanor despite our large group. His welcoming energy and hospitality truly elevated our dining experience. Thank You Sooraj !!

reviews.author: mähë
reviews.text:
Visited Calicut Stories Restaurant in Karama and had a great experience. The restaurant has a clean, well-designed interior with a pleasant atmosphere, making it a nice place for families and friends.
I ordered the biryani, and it was satisfying. I actually went there on a Friday hoping to have Kerala meals, but I found out that on Fridays they serve only biryanis and not Kerala meals. It was a little disappointing, but the quality of the food made up for it.
Overall, it's a good restaurant with tasty food, a comfortable ambiance, and a family-friendly environment. I would definitely recommend it and look forward to visiting again.

reviews.author: Rajendra Kumar
reviews.text:
An authentic Kerala dining experience in Al Karama, typically bustling on weekends with wait times exceeding one hour.

Upon arrival, guests are greeted with cinnamon-infused hot water, beneficial for digestion. I ordered a chicken and tawa prawn  side dish accompanied by their exceptionally soft, melt-in-your-mouth Parotta.

The juicy mandy is highly recommended.
Embrace the weekend atmosphere in Al Karama.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you, Rajendra, for such a thoughtful review! We’re glad you enjoyed the food.

The weekend buzz in Karama can certainly come with a bit of a wait, but we truly appreciate your patience and understanding. Your kind words mean a lot to our team, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another dining experience soon.

reviews.author: Amalanda Biju
reviews.text:
Visited Calicut Stories in Karama recently and it turned out to be such a lovely experience.

We started with the prawn tava fry — super yummy and full of flavor. For the main course, we had garlic butter naan with butter chicken, and that combo was really satisfying. We also tried the charcoal dish, which was just average, but everything else was honestly so good.

Overall, a very satisfying meal. The ambiance was great too — calm and really pleasant. Definitely a place worth visiting!
reviews.owner_reply:
Really glad you had such a lovely experience with us.

Great to hear you enjoyed the prawn tava fry and the butter chicken with garlic butter naan—that combo is always a favorite. Noted your honest feedback on the charcoal dish as well.

Happy you liked the ambience too. We look forward to welcoming you again soon.
